properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 18 at 5:48AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
Clear and calm conditions have resulted in valley fog developing
throughout the region, especially in the river valleys. Areas of
dense fog will be possible this morning, with visibilities below
a quarter of a mile at times in the thickest of the fog. Be sure
to slow down and use your low beam headlights when you encounter
any fog. The fog will begin to slowly dissipate shortly after
sunrise.

properties.areaDesc: Virginia Beach
properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 18 at 5:36AM EDT until October 21 at 7:00AM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 8 to
13 feet in the surf zone. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, up to
one foot of inundation above ground level expected in low- lying
areas near shorelines and tidal waterways. For the Coastal Flood
Watch, one to two feet of inundation above ground level
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Virginia Beach.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 7 AM EDT Wednesday.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 1 PM this afternoon to 7
PM EDT this evening. For the Coastal Flood Watch, from Monday
afternoon through Wednesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
may be inundated. Some shoreline erosion may occur. Dangerous
swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach erosion.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Guam...

* WHEN...Until 830 PM ChST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 730 PM ChST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain. This will
cause urban and small stream flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Dededo, Tamuning, Yigo, Mangilao, Chalan Pago-Ordot, Barrigada,
Yona, Hagatna Heights, Andersen AFB, Talofofo,
Mongmong-Toto-Maite, Sinajana, Inarajan, Asan, Merizo, Piti,
Santa Rita and Umatac.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.
